No external artifact supports a claim without digest and subject binding.
Generated AI output lands as inferred.
Stale evidence remains visible and cannot render green/proof.
Lossiness must be declared when projecting non-native evidence.
Personnel-sensitive evidence is minimized by default.
A scan result must match the release or subject it claims to support.
A bill of materials must be bound to a product, release, model, system, or dataset.
No extension manifest can be exported without schema and reason.
No export bundle leaves without manifest, hash, and redaction state.
